$comment: The study types a planned deliverable may declare (evimed_plan, deliverables[].studyType), and the reporting guideline each one is written to. Data, not code: a methodologist edits a row here. Absent means the deliverable reports no one study. A type whose guideline is null is still worth declaring — the delegation brief and the independent reviewer name the design — and gets its guideline the day one is added: a row in `guidelines`, the item table under capability-skills/reporting-guidelines/checklists/<id>.md, and the reviewer's list in apps/server/src/reviewChecklists.json (byStudyType, same id; a test holds the three together). The reviewer's item texts are deliberately not here: this package ships inside the runtime.
